commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- README.md delivery.md tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; git log -1 --format='%h %s'; rg --files --hidden -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'! .git'"' -g '"'!.git/**'"'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat tasklist/tasks.py tasklist/cli.py tests/test_tasks.py; git ls-files; shasum tasklist/*.py tests/test_tasks.py docs/export-notes.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root = Path.cwd()
count = 0
for page in root.rglob('*.md'):
    if '.git' in page.parts:
        continue
    content = page.read_text()
    assert 'work/investigation/repeated-completion.md' not in content, page
    for link in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]*\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', content):
        path, _, anchor = link.partition('#')
        target = page.parent / path if path else page
        assert target.exists(), (page, link)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'"'^#+'"\\s+(.+)"'$'"', target.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'["'^'"\\w\\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in anchors, (page, link)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local Markdown links and anchors; no links to the completed investigation remain.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- delivery.md; cat docs/task-completion.md; git status --short; shasum tasklist/*.py tests/test_tasks.py docs/export-notes.md'
